# ln

Create symbolic links through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/ln -s target.txt link.txt

moonx cli/ln -sr target.txt relative-link.txt
```

Use -s to create a symbolic link. Relative targets, explicit target directories, replacement and backups are supported on POSIX hosts.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-s`, `--symbolic` | Create a symbolic link; required. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Replace an existing destination without prompting. |
| `-i`, `--interactive` | Ask before replacing an existing destination. |
| `-r`, `--relative` | Use a relative symbolic-link target. |
| `-n`, `--no-dereference` | Do not follow a destination directory symlink. |
| `-t VALUE`, `--target-directory VALUE` | Create links in DIR. |
| `--backup=CONTROL` | Select the documented backup naming policy. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Hard links and Windows link creation are unsupported. Declining a replacement, including EOF, returns status 1.
- If creation and backup restoration both fail, the diagnostic names both paths; inspect them before retrying.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
